follow-up time: Hospital records up to 2014 for births 1999-2014
exposure: failure of labor to progress during the 1st or 2nd stage
cohort: 9956 singleton newborns born between 1999-2014 at a single tertiary regional medical center
finding: Non-reassuring fetal heart rate patterns were not associated with increased risk of long-term pediatric cardiovascular morbidity.
mod_finding: The study compared outcomes in offspring born by caesarean delivery (CD) due to non-reassuring fetal heart rate (NRFHR) versus labor dystocia, finding no association between NRFHR patterns and the risk for subsequent pediatric cardiovascular morbidity.
